title: illumos Distro Variables
description: Configuration variables for illumos/OmniOS distribution synthesis.

ILLUMOS_DISTRO_VERSION.description: Target illumos/OmniOS release version to synthesize.

ILLUMOS_DISTRO_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to run illumos distro synthesis ('libscript_native' or 'system').

ILLUMOS_DISTRO_FETCH_BASE.description: Flag (0 or 1) instructing synthesis/distro/illumos/base.sh to fetch and extract upstream OmniOS, OpenIndiana, Tribblix, or SmartOS base archives.
